answer: Sequential delay admission. A new identity starts as a hollow seat: it can be named but earns and votes nothing. To fill it, the owner computes a verifiable delay function seeded with the epoch beacon and the seat key: 6 hours of strictly serial squarings on one core. The proof is the signal that unlocks the seat, and extra hardware cannot shorten it. So 500 fakes cost 3,000 core-hours, paid whether or not any is caught. Seats then sit in a tundra tier at 10% reward weight for 20 epochs.
